g.text: The actual full-state marginal ground equation
All remaining faces and gradient contributions retained
Spatial projection in the upper-left view: (X,Y,Z) → (X+9Y/20, Z+3Y/10).
The orange face uses one selected edge and one outside edge; its mixed term
prevents additive separation of the original full Wilson potential.
